intro.text: The host of a party in her Elendel penthouse at which the governor, Replar Innate, was due to give his spring dinner address.
A well-connected member of Elendel's elite who owns ZoBell Tower, a twenty-storey skyscraper in the Fourth Octant with a ballroom in its penthouse.

items.text: In 342 PC she held a red-carpet party in her penthouse for nobles from Elendel and other Basin cities, where the governor was due to deliver his spring policy address. After a recent attempt on his life, security was tightened and some guests turned away. Wax and his friends ran into Bleeder at the party, though nothing suggests Lady ZoBell knew.
